Canyon Rim Pediatrics, P.A. - Office visit

Patient	DOB	MRN	Visit date

OKAFOR-JIMENEZ, MATEO	04/17/2019	CRP-0088214	10/27/2026

Provider: Hannah Goldfarb-Reyes, MD (NPI 1629407715). Accompanied by: mother, Adaeze Okafor. Insurance: Sandia Peaks Health Cooperative, member ID SPH-771-204-88-02.

Subjective

Mateo is a 7-year-old boy with type 1 diabetes (diagnosed March 2024) and mild persistent asthma, here for a three-month follow-up. Mom reports two overnight lows in the 50s in the past month, both after soccer. No ketones, no ER visits. He used his rescue inhaler about twice a week during the smoke days in September.

School: second grade at Juniper Ridge Elementary. The school nurse, Tamsin Whitehorse, has asked for an updated diabetes plan; his 504 plan is due for review. Mom says Ms. Whitehorse is only on site Mondays and Wednesdays.

Social: Parents separated in the spring. Mateo is with his father, Luis Jimenez, on alternate weekends. Mom is worried that dad does not count carbs and that weekend numbers run high. She asked that the pump reports not be mailed to the old address. Family speaks Igbo and Spanish at home; Mateo answers me in English.

Objective

Measure	Today	Last visit

Weight	24.1 kg	23.2 kg

Height	124 cm	122.5 cm

A1c	7.9%	7.4%

Time in range	58%	66%

Exam: well appearing, lungs clear, mild lipohypertrophy at the left abdomen infusion sites. Insulin pump serial PAA-3381-20417; CGM transmitter 8HX2K7, paired to mom's phone.

Assessment and plan

- Type 1 diabetes, above goal (ICD-10 E10.65). Change overnight basal from 0.35 units/hr to 0.30 units/hr on activity days. Rotate sites; avoid left abdomen for a month.

- Asthma, controlled (J45.30). Continue fluticasone 44 mcg, 2 puffs twice daily. Flu vaccine given today, lot UJ417AB.

- Refills sent to Mesa Vista Pharmacy, 505-555-0112: insulin lispro, Rx #7740291; test strips.

- New school orders faxed to the nurse at 505-555-0191. Copy to mom through the portal, https://portal.canyonrimpeds.example/chart/0088214.

- Offered a visit with our social worker about the two-household routine. Mom will think about it. With her consent I will send Mr. Jimenez the same carb-counting handout; his email on file is luis.jimenez77@inbox.example.

Billing: CPT 99214. Return in 3 months, sooner for lows under 54.
